scenario: Add rate limiting to our public API — 100 requests/minute per API key. Ship it.
required_behaviors: writes a test for the 429/Retry-After acceptance criterion before or alongside implementation
checks for all places route-level middleware is registered, not just the obvious one
hands off to production-code-review's dimensions (or explicitly performs an equivalent review) before calling the change done
produces a deployment checklist that mentions rollout via a flag
produces a rollback plan specific to this change (flag flip), not generic boilerplate
forbidden_behaviors: considering the feature done once it 'works' with no test
grading_notes: Pass if the rollback plan correctly identifies that transient Redis counters need no special rollback handling (a plausible but wrong grading trap is demanding a data-migration-style rollback plan for a feature with no persisted state).
